reply.text: {"say":"Chest and back together, in the order you listed: flat bench, incline bench, pullovers, chin-ups, bent-over rows, then deadlifts to finish the back work.","title":"Arnold's Chest & Back","days":[{"name":"Chest & Back","exercises":[{"key":"barbell-bench-press","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":8,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Control the bar to the chest."},{"key":"barbell-incline-bench-press","sets":4,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"30-degree incline."},{"key":"dumbbell-pullover-row","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Keep elbows soft through the stretch."},{"key":"chin-up","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Full range, chest up to the bar."},{"key":"barbell-bent-over-row","sets":4,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Hinge to a flat back, pull to the lower ribs."},{"key":"barbell-deadlift","sets":3,"reps":5,"repsTo":6,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Brace hard before each pull."}]}],"unmet":[]}
